data.description:
## Problem

After a reclaim publish-swap, a clone whose `origin/tickets` was already fetched to the rewritten baseline refuses every ticket write as DIVERGED, even though the remote's store epoch provably supersedes the local one and `_store/sync.py::_override_if_reclaimed` would move the clone onto the new history.

Observed 2026-11-20 PST after publishing 6a6dda16fc7: the box MCP server's first write (`comment_ticket`) failed with "ticket write refused: the local ticket store has DIVERGED from the shared store with no shared ancestor". The same write through the local CLI succeeded and the sync logged "clone moved onto reclaimed remote … replayed 0 unpushed event(s)". The MCP clone had to be reset by hand.

## Cause (from source)

`_commands/_seam.py::finalize_event` calls `_refuse_unpublishable_store` → `_store/freshness.py::write_blocking_divergence`, which returns `diverged` whenever `merge-base HEAD <remote>/<branch>` fails. It does not consult `compat.remote_epoch_supersedes_local`, so a reclaimed-superseded clone is refused before the sync step that would heal it ever runs. Not yet established: why the local CLI write did not hit the same refusal (whether it fetched/synced before `finalize_event`, or its remote-tracking ref was in a different state at that moment).

## Fix

`write_blocking_divergence` returns `None` when `compat.remote_epoch_supersedes_local(tracker, <remote_ref commit>)` is true, so the write commits and the push/sync path's stale-clone override carries it onto the reclaimed baseline (a fresh unpushed event is replayed byte-identically). No new config key, env var or flag.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A regression test builds a clone on epoch A, a remote rewritten to epoch B whose lineage names A, fetches the remote ref, and performs a ticket write through the shared seam: the write succeeds and the event is on the remote tip. The test fails on current main.
- [ ] A remote with an unrelated history (lineage does not name the local epoch) is still refused as DIVERGED.
- [ ] `make verify` passes.
data.title: Write precheck refuses a clone a reclaim superseded
